description: Best gasless route to move a token from one Robyn chain to another. Returns estimated output, the bridge used, duration, and the Robyn fee. Read-only — moves nothing.

amount.description: amount in fromToken base units (e.g. "25000000" = 25 USDC)

fromToken.description: token address on the source chain (0x0000…0000 for native)

toToken.description: token address / symbol on the destination

name: robyn_quote
title: Quote a gasless cross-chain route
